record.one_liner: Meta's Threads API for publishing and reading Threads posts, profiles, replies and insights.
record.auth_notes: Threads user access tokens obtained through the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Window, with scopes such as threads_basic and threads_content_publish.
record.access_notes: Apps are created in the developer dashboard, but permissions must pass App Review and the app must be published before other users can grant them. Official docs do not clearly confirm an unreviewed Development-mode path for the developer's own account.
record.api_notes: Covers posts (text, image, video, carousel), media, profiles, replies, moderation, mentions, insights, webhooks and keyword search per the docs index.
record.blocker_notes: Permissions need Meta App Review and a published app before production use. No official Meta MCP server was found; only community servers.
